body_height_definition: Manual anatomical crown y190 to midpoint of two projected boot sole contacts y1127. Excludes feather adornment, wings and bow. One fixed anatomy baseline for future approved poses; never alpha-bounds-fit each pose.
anatomical_crown_to_lowest_boot_definiti: Supplementary vertical extent from crown y190 to lowest visible boot sole y1214; not runtime scaling baseline.
scope: Local presentation pilot only. Does not change navigation radius, collider, stats, attack distance, projectile origin or public presentation metrics.

frames.name: idle
frames.pose: Grounded front-right relaxed ready pose. Bow held in left hand, right hand at torso. No arrow drawn.
frames.anchor_accuracy: Manual visual estimates, approximately +/-10 source pixels; outlet is an inferred arrow-rest location because this idle pose has no nocked arrow.
frames.visual_outlet_limit: Visual metadata only. Current gameplay projectile still originates at actor.position and retains its existing frozen target and collision behavior.

visual_review.concept_identity: Ivory/blue lightweight adult human-faced winged archer with restrained gold fittings and long feather-shaped bow. Compact white layered wings now end near waist. No beak, dragon horns, heavy lance, cathedral-size wings or tail.
visual_review.hands_and_feet: Both hands and both boots visible. Bow hand wraps grip; free hand rests at torso. Wing roots read behind shoulders.
visual_review.camera: Elevated three-quarter view showing top of hair and shoulders; parent/in-game review still required for exact camera compatibility.
visual_review.framing_note: Entire silhouette stays within native canvas. Requested 8% margins were not fully achieved: bow top is 25px at alpha>16. No cropping observed.
visual_review.alpha_note: Native alpha has sparse near-transparent colored residues. Saturated red pixel counts: alpha>0 4375, alpha>1 37, alpha>8 0. This is not proof of uncontaminated composites; bright/dark-background and real-game sampling must be inspected. No alpha thresholding or pixel cleanup was applied.

completion_limits: No runtime integration or actual L43 in-game acceptance

parent_art_review.approved_scope: Idle pilot source identity, palette, bow and compact wings only

staged_renderer_review.setup: Same frame with unchanged production CH01 hero at112, M01 ordinary formula82.08 and proposed M01 body100; second frame enlarges the whole world equally2x. Source pixels untouched.
findings: 100 reads as a slim, slightly shorter adult beside unchanged112hero;82.08 reads conspicuously undersized.
Projected midpoint anchor places both visible boots plausibly on the implied ground plane.
Elevated three-quarter camera and costume finish are compatible with the production hero.
Feather bow, visible string, short white wings and blue/ivory body stay readable.
No obvious colored alpha fringe seen on the tested light-gray/blue-gray backgrounds at runtime scale or equal2x detail.
staged_renderer_review.bounds: This is a staged unintegrated engine-renderer comparison, not the actual L43 map, combat, animation or lighting acceptance. Low-alpha source residues remain unchanged and are still recorded as a sampling risk.
